items.decision_note: Message 2 refers to the expected notes or letter but does not itself state the annotated length and contents; message 1 must be reviewed to determine whether it is the proper introduction source or an unambiguously accepted proposal.

unresolved_candidate.description: The client's goal of creating mystery and a sense of the unknown may be an editorial acceptance criterion, but the message frames it primarily as the client's own revision intention rather than a clear independent request to the freelancer.
